purpose: Define deterministic static-site, cross-browser smoke and Lighthouse quality gates for the published AETHERIA catalog, VX4800 viewer and VX4800 technical inspector without changing product engineering authority.
notes: Lighthouse score floors are regression gates, not marketing claims and not a substitute for physical-device review.
Playwright iPhone/Android projects are browser/device emulations; they do not prove behavior on every physical handset or OS build.
The immutable V5.2 presentation is audited as published and is not modified merely to improve a Lighthouse score.
Performance and browser QA are software-delivery evidence only and do not change VX4800 engineering, manufacturing, photometry or certification authority.
